title: Economic Freedom and Financial Security for Working People Act of 2018
short_title: Economic Freedom and Financial Security for Working People Act of 2018

actions.text: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committee on Education and the Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Regulatory Reform, Commercial And Antitrust Law.

summaries.text:
Economic Freedom and Financial Security for Working People Act of 2018
 This bill amends the Clayton Act to establish that a corporate acquisition that tends to create a monopsony (i.e., a situation where a single buyer substantially controls the purchasing power in a market for a good or service) is a violation of antitrust law. Currently, the Clayton Act prohibits only acquisitions that would lead to a monopoly (i.e., where a single supplier of a good or service substantially controls the market).
